versions.subject: new rules related to possible dll sideloading
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:

    - 'libwinpthread-1.dll'
filter:

condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: feat: new rules, updates and goofy guineapig stuff (#4229)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\libwazuhshared.dll'
        - '\libwinpthread-1.dll'
filter_main_generic:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
filter_optional_mingw64:
    # Note: Many third party apps installed in "AppData" or "ProgramData" and leverage "mingw64" make use of "libwinpthread-1.dll"
    # In production its best to make a list of these apps and replace this filter with a specific one.
    ImageLoaded|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '\ProgramData\'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\mingw64\bin\libwinpthread-1.dll'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded IN ("*\\libwazuhshared.dll", "*\\libwinpthread-1.dll") NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*")) NOT (ImageLoaded IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*") ImageLoaded="*\\mingw64\\bin\\libwinpthread-1.dll")
